title: Sagittarius, month four of casual
old_caption: Month one: two mugs. Month four: a shared plant with a name tag. Sag is still calling it casual, but finally told the camera the truth. Next stop: telling them.

title: Capricorn's advice, for everyone else
old_caption: Three phones, three perfect pieces of advice, then one question about their own crush and the loading bar hit 99%. Tag the friend who should read their own texts.

title: Aquarius has no feelings (allegedly)
old_caption:
Emotionally unbothered, according to Aquarius. According to the heart monitor, very much bothered by one specific laugh.
Which sign is your group's unbothered one?

title: Pisces finally gets the chair
old_caption: Pisces finally gets the confessional chair and cries before the first question. A dog in a scarf, two snacks from one machine, a nice cloud. Zero regrets.

title: Everyone's in the booth at 2 a.m.
old_caption:
2:04 a.m. confessions: checking one thing, rereading old texts, typing a reply that will never send. Pisces is crying at a duck video.
Which booth are you in tonight?

title: Left on read: the support group
old_caption: Day three of left on read. One reread it forty ways, one is just near their phone, one made a casserole about it. Then the phone buzzed. It had died.

title: Single at the holiday dinner
old_caption:
"So, seeing anyone?" Four singles, four answers, one round of seconds. Single at the table and genuinely fine about it.
What's your answer this year?

title: Episode: The Double Text
old_caption:
Someone at this dinner double texted, and a phone on the table is about to buzz. Aries, Virgo and Pisces spill everything before the verdict.
Who in your group sends the second text?

title: Episode: The Ex Walks In
old_caption: Leo invited everyone. Everyone included the ex. One spit-take, one flying gravy boat and one very calm Scorpio later, Cancer has something to say on the porch.

title: Episode: The Situationship Summit
old_caption: Three situationships, one dinner and a talk card nobody wants to touch: What are we? Sag, Gemini and Taurus finally ask. Not every answer is a yes, and that's okay too.
